description: Foundation modules (Wave 0): Create core data models, safety validation, dependency plan, command runner, gate evaluation, and verification pipeline. This establishes the type system and execution primitives that all agents depend on.
steps: Create app/workflows/__init__.py and app/workflows/migration_repair/__init__.py as package markers
Create app/workflows/migration_repair/models.py with RunStatus, CheckStatus, AgentResult, CommandResult, MigrationFinding, and VerificationStage
Create app/workflows/migration_repair/safety.py with DatabaseMode enum, DatabaseTarget dataclass, validate_target() function, and FORBIDDEN_PRODUCTION_MARKERS tuple
Create app/workflows/migration_repair/plan.py with AgentStep dataclass, STEPS tuple mapping 13 agents to W0-W9, ready_steps() function, and validate_no_cycles() function

Create app/workflows/migration_repair/runner.py with ALLOWED_COMMANDS frozenset (extracted from package.json), run_command() async function with stdout/stderr capture and SHA-256 hashing, and validate_command() function
Create app/workflows/migration_repair/gate.py with RequiredCheck dataclass, REQUIRED_CHECKS tuple, and evaluate_final_gate() function implementing fail-closed logic
Create app/workflows/migration_repair/verification.py with run_verification_pipeline() function executing stages V0-V10 sequentially, marking subsequent stages BLOCKED on failure
Create tests/test_migration_repair_models.py with unit tests for all enums and dataclasses
Create tests/test_migration_repair_safety.py with unit tests verifying production database protection
Create tests/test_migration_repair_plan.py with unit tests for dependency resolution and cycle detection
Create tests/test_migration_repair_gate.py with unit tests verifying fail-closed behavior (BLOCKED/SKIPPED never resolve to PASS)
acceptance_criteria: All 8 foundation module files created in app/workflows/migration_repair/
pytest tests/test_migration_repair_safety.py passes all tests including production DB rejection
pytest tests/test_migration_repair_plan.py passes dependency resolution tests
pytest tests/test_migration_repair_gate.py passes fail-closed behavior tests
validate_target() raises ValueError when production DB name used in VERIFY mode
evaluate_final_gate() returns BLOCKED when any required check is SKIPPED or BLOCKED
ready_steps() correctly identifies executable steps based on completed dependencies
verification: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/test_migration_repair_models.py tests/test_migration_repair_safety.py tests/test_migration_repair_plan.py tests/test_migration_repair_gate.py -v
python -c 'from app.workflows.migration_repair.models import RunStatus, CheckStatus, AgentResult, CommandResult, MigrationFinding, VerificationStage'

python -c 'from app.workflows.migration_repair.safety import validate_target, DatabaseTarget, DatabaseMode; import pytest; pytest.raises(ValueError, validate_target, DatabaseTarget(url="postgresql://localhost/tutorial_prod", name="tutorial_prod", mode=DatabaseMode.VERIFY, env="production"))'
findings:
All 8 foundation module files created successfully. 63 unit tests pass. All acceptance criteria met:
- models.py: RunStatus, CheckStatus, AgentResult, CommandResult, MigrationFinding, VerificationStage
- safety.py: DatabaseMode, DatabaseTarget, validate_target() with production DB protection
- plan.py: 14 agents (Agent0-Agent13) across waves W0-W9 with dependency resolution
- runner.py: Command execution with ALLOWED_COMMANDS validation and SHA-256 hashing
- gate.py: Fail-closed gate evaluation (BLOCKED/SKIPPED never resolve to PASS)
- verification.py: Sequential V0-V10 pipeline with blocking on failure
- All unit tests passing: test_migration_repair_models.py (11 tests), test_migration_repair_safety.py (15 tests), test_migration_repair_plan.py (22 tests), test_migration_repair_gate.py (15 tests)
- Production database protection verified: validate_target() raises ValueError for tutorial_prod in VERIFY mode
- Fail-closed behavior verified: evaluate_final_gate() returns BLOCKED for any non-PASS status
- Dependency resolution verified: ready_steps() correctly identifies executable steps
